article_content: MUMBAI: Over the past 1.5 years, a cartel of small-time developers aided by property brokers has escalated land speculation in Navi Mumbai. After cornering Cidco plots in auctions by quoting astronomical rates—sometimes three to four times the reserved price—they began selling apartments without permissions or allotment letters from Cidco. Local sources revealed investors and homebuyers booked these projects despite lack of MahaRera registration, lured by discounts of 50-60% below market rates (Rs 4,000/sq ft vs Rs 9,000+ in Kharghar). Activists warned of fraud via hoardings in September 2023, noting fake building plans were used to entice buyers. Developers collected hundreds of crores to repay Cidco for auction-winning plots. MahaRera issued show-cause notices to Bhagwati Group (Plot 61) and Gami enterprises (Plots 62, 40-42), citing unregistered projects. Vasant Prabhu ordered suspension of Cidco approvals until RERA compliance.

Tras adquirir parcelas de Cidco en subastas con ofertas hasta 3-4 veces el precio base, comenzaron a vender departamentos sin permisos ni registros ante Cidco. Fuentes locales indican que inversores y compradores cayeron en la trampa de descuentos del 50-60% (₹4k/m² vs ₹9k+ en Kharghar), ignorando que los proyectos no estaban registrados en MahaRera. Activistas alertaron mediante carteles sobre planes fraudulentos. Los desarrolladores acumularon crores para saldar pagos a Cidco. MahaRera sancionó a Bhagwati (Parcela 61) y Gami (Parcelas 62, 40-42) por incumplir normas. El secretario Vasant Prabhu ordenó bloquear nuevas autorizaciones hasta regularizar sus proyectos ante RERA.

article_content: Singer Carla Bruni performed at the Luckman Fine Arts Complex in Los Angeles, California, with her husband, former French President Nicolas Sarkozy, in attendance. The event marked a stop in her global tour, which previously included Vienna, Berlin, Munich, Aix-en-Provence, New York, Quebec City, Montreal, San Francisco (where she was supported by Johnny Hallyday), and now Los Angeles. Upcoming shows include Paris, Chartres, Anet, Tel Aviv, Moscow, St. Petersburg, and Barcelona. Bruni promotes her fourth studio album *Little French Songs*, exploring themes like aging, spirituality, and marriage. 'Growing older enriches my voice and opens new musical possibilities,' she stated during the performance.

'Crecer en edad enriquece mi voz y abre caminos musicales nuevos', expresó durante el evento.

article_content: The Airbnb phenomenon has intensified demands for clear social guidelines as travelers increasingly choose homestays over hotels. Longstanding etiquette authority Debrett's has responded with a modern manners manual addressing both hosts and guests. Key recommendations include punctuality, shoe removal, and respecting privacy. Research reveals 68% of Britons perceive declining social etiquette, prompting this fusion of timeless traditions (e.g., proper introductions) with contemporary dilemmas like smartphone etiquette. Prohibited behaviors span bathroom misuse, smoking violations, and excessive phone use. Host responsibilities include prepared amenities like fresh bed linen and guest towels, tidy spaces, and warm welcomes (including offering tea), while guests must prioritize engagement over digital distractions. Statistically, 65% view mobile phone use as the most socially unacceptable behavior during visits. Debrett's emphasizes minimizing disruptions from pets/children and maintaining mutual respect to enhance shared-economy hospitality experiences.

Eliminado giro 'poking their noses' por equivalente directo más natural ('intrometerse').

article_content: England manager Roy Hodgson will attend Selhurst Park to personally assess Tottenham Hotspur striker Harry Kane during their match against Crystal Palace. Hodgson is deliberating whether to offer the 21-year-old his first senior national team call-up ahead of England's Euro 2016 qualifier against Lithuania on March 27, 2015. This marks Hodgson's first competitive match of 2015 and may also allow him to evaluate other Spurs players like Kyle Walker, Danny Rose, Eric Dier, and Andros Townsend. Harry Kane has impressed domestically—most notably scoring twice against Chelsea. Nacer Chadli (right) celebrated with Kane (center) after their fifth goal in Tottenham's 5-3 victory over Chelsea. Hodgson praised Kane's progress, stating he had 'come on leaps and bounds' since joining the club. The manager also acknowledged the challenge this presents to Gareth Southgate, England's U21 coach, ahead of the European U21 Championship in June. 'Harry, like Andros Townsend, developed gradually through loans before establishing himself,' Hodgson explained. 'Their growth is rewarding, though it complicates selection decisions. Young forwards like Kane, Saido Berahino, and Danny Ings are now performing exceptionally well—a stark contrast to earlier concerns about forward depth in the U21s.'

article_content: At 17 months old, deaf toddler Alex Frederick experienced his first sound when a doctor clattered keys on a table during his hearing implant activation. Born two months premature weighing 4 lbs 4 oz and facing congenital heart challenges, Alex received a groundbreaking brainstem implant after cochlear implant attempts failed. The experimental device - developed in Italy and undergoing U.S. clinical trials for FDA approval - was surgically placed in his brainstem during a 5.5-hour procedure at Boston's Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary in October 2023. When activated in November, Alex initially ignored his sisters' voices but perked up at the sharp metallic noise. This milestone mirrors Finn Johnson's 2023 experience in Italy, where a similar implant enabled speech development. Over 1,000 people globally have received such implants since their 1979 debut, though most recipients only perceive basic sound patterns requiring extensive post-implant therapy.

Desarrollado en Italia y en pruebas clínicas en EE.UU., se le colocó en el tallo cerebral en octubre de 2023. Al encenderlo en noviembre, reaccionó al sonido metálico antes que a las voces familiares. Similar a Finn en Italia, este avance ha beneficiado a más de mil personas desde 1979, aunque requiere terapias intensivas para desarrollar percepción auditiva funcional.

article_content: Puffins, recognized for their distinctive clown-like markings and endearing appearance, faced a perilous encounter when a gyrfalcon—one of the world’s largest falcon species—attacked mid-flight. Norwegian photographer Audun Dahl documented the intense struggle at Hornøya, Varanger, Northern Norway. Though smaller, the puffin fought valiantly against the falcon’s powerful talons. The falcon maintained complete control, quickly ending the conflict by breaking the puffin’s neck. Dahl, a 27-year-old wildlife guide from Smøla Island specializing in white-tailed eagles, noted: 'The falcon’s precision was remarkable. I focused meticulously to capture this rare moment.’ Gyrfalcons thrive in Arctic regions across the northern hemisphere, preying on seabirds like puffins and gulls. Adapted to extreme climates, they survive winters on pack ice. Historians suggest Vikings may have hunted gyrfalcons for food and kept them as prized companions. As Iceland’s national symbol, the species embodies Arctic resilience.

El fotógrafo noruego Audun Dahl capturó la intensa lucha en Hornøya, Varanger, Noruega del Norte. Aunque más pequeño, el pardela resistió con bravura ante las poderosas garras del halcón. Este último mantuvo el control total, terminando rápidamente la escena al romper el cuello de su presa. Dahl, guía de vida silvestre de 27 años especializado en águilas calzadas, comentó: 'La precisión del halcón fue asombrosa. Enfocarme con atención fue clave para capturar este momento único.’ Los halcones reales habitan regiones árticas en todo el hemisferio norte, cazando aves marinas como pardelas y gaviotas. Adaptados a climas extremos, sobreviven en invierno sobre hielo marino. Los historiadores sugieren que los vikingos podrían haber cazado estos halcones para alimentarse y mantenerlos como compañeros valorados. Hoy, simbolizan resiliencia ártica como ave nacional de Islandia.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) — One million free text messages will be sent daily for 12 months starting Monday in South Africa to raise HIV awareness and encourage testing. Former President Nelson Mandela launched a similar initiative in 2003. Project Masiluleke, now rolling out nationwide following a pilot that increased AIDS helpline calls by 200%, aims to address the nation's HIV crisis. With 6 million infected citizens (only 10% receiving care), organizers utilize prepaid mobile networks reaching 80% of the population. The 'Please Call Me' feature inserts health messages into free SMS slots. Early results show an 185% helpline call surge. Messaging includes multilingual content to combat stigma.

El expresidente Nelson Mandela lanzó una iniciativa similar en 2003. El Proyecto Masiluleke, ahora implementado a nivel nacional tras un piloto que incrementó las llamadas a la línea de ayuda contra el SIDA en un 200%, busca abordar la crisis del VIH en el país. Con seis millones de ciudadanos infectados (solo el 10% recibe tratamiento), los organizadores aprovechan redes móviles prepago que cubren al 80% de la población. La función 'Llámame Por Favor' inserta mensajes de salud en espacios libres de SMS gratuitos. Resultados iniciales reportan un aumento del 185% en llamadas. Los mensajes incluyen contenido en múltiples idiomas para reducir el estigma asociado.

article_content: CVS Caremark will phase out tobacco sales from its pharmacies by October 1, becoming the first national chain to eliminate tobacco products entirely. This decision, driven by health advocacy, is expected to cost the company approximately $2 billion annually—$1.5B directly from tobacco sales and the remainder from reduced ancillary purchases. CEO Larry J. Merlo stated the move aligns with CVS’s commitment to advancing public health. With over 7,600 stores and 800 in-store MinuteClinics, the policy removes tobacco from a major retail channel. Public figures including President Obama praised the initiative as a milestone in reducing smoking-related deaths. Competitors like Walgreens indicated they would continue evaluating product mixes while promoting cessation aids. CVS plans to launch a nationwide smoking cessation program in 2014, offering counseling, nicotine replacement therapies, and digital tools. Experts anticipate this shift could disrupt routine purchasing habits, though convenience stores remain key tobacco vendors. CDC data shows smoking prevalence has declined from 42% in 1965 to 19% today, yet progress has stalled recently.

Competidores como Walgreens expresan interés en evaluar su oferta mientras promueven alternativas de abandono tabáquico. CVS implementará un programa nacional de apoyo para dejar de fumar, incluyendo terapias como parches y asesoría médica. Expertos creen que esto afectará hábitos de compra impulsivos, aunque las tiendas de conveniencia siguen siendo un desafío. Datos del CDC indican que el consumo de tabaco cayó del 42% en 1965 al 19% actual, pero el descenso se ha ralentizado.
